title: 第1263章 南明离火涅盘姬鲲冲击中期第1262章 斩归海元
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
李青元看着各种资源。
二阶仙丹两颗、一阶仙丹八颗，仙晶六百多块，各种修炼资源加仙品材料也价值三百仙晶。
紫火晶数十块，其中两块达到真仙初期，不错、不错。
汹！
一团火焰燃烧着，火苗蒸腾虚空。
海蓝色火焰如液态流转，至柔至韧，温度却高得惊人，周围的虚空被灼烧得微微扭曲，地面上出现一道道融化的裂纹。
虽然火焰只有一丈大小、极致内敛，却蕴含焚山煮海的力量。
李青元面露微笑：没想到还有意外收获。
这朵海心坤元火，已经成长到了二阶仙火级别。
海心坤元火，坤阴之火，至柔至韧，可焚万物，归海元温养于本命法宝中十万年，火灵已有相当灵智，火焰法则也颇为凝练。
若是真仙中期修士炼化此火，加上高明的控火之术辅助，战力绝对属于同阶顶尖。
李青元抬手，南明离火飞出。
橘红色火焰飞出掌心的瞬间，火灵的意志波动骤然变得剧烈，它刚一见到海心坤元火，顿时爆发强烈吞噬欲望。
橘红色火焰暴涨，幻化成为朱雀形态。
一只丈许大小的微型朱雀在虚空中展翅，橘红羽翼上紫意流转，喙如利剑，双目如炬——南明离火的本源形态，上古四灵神兽之一的朱雀法相。
朱雀长啸，扑向海心坤元火。
南明离火突然出现，惊动了海心坤元火。
海蓝色火焰猛然一缩，火灵本能恐惧，二阶仙火的火灵已有相当灵智，能清晰地感知到南明离火身上那股先天神火的压制之力。
这是先天神火对后天仙火的天然克制，如同真龙压制蛇蟒，凤凰压制凡禽。
海心坤元火疯狂爆发仙火力量，海蓝色火焰如潮水般涌出，欲要飞遁逃走。

“想走？”
然而，李青元五指一握，五灾之力将其禁锢。
五色神光无声无息地笼罩海心坤元火，五灾合一，二阶仙火动弹不得。
海心坤元火成为待宰羔羊，火灵剧烈挣扎，海蓝色火焰不断冲击五色神光的禁锢，却如困兽之斗，毫无作用。
最终还是被南明离火化形的朱雀神兽一口吞噬。
朱雀展翅，喙如利剑，一口叼住海心坤元火，整个吞入腹中，海蓝色火焰被橘红色火焰包裹，迅速融化、吸收、炼化。
南明离火吞噬后，一阶仙火本源燃烧。
先天神火涅盘属性爆发，南明离火不同于寻常火焰，它是先天神火，天生便拥有涅盘进化之能。
犹如一只万丈朱雀神兽即将涅盘进化。
一声朱雀长啸响彻天际，方圆百万里都能感知到那股火焰法则的剧变。
朱雀法相暴涨至万丈，橘红羽翼上紫意大盛，火焰温度骤升数倍，虚空在朱雀法相周围被烧得龟裂，大地融化成岩浆。
火之大道法则在朱雀体内翻涌蜕变，海心坤元火的二阶仙火本源被南明离火的先天神火同化、吸收、融合。
content_en:
Li Qingyuan looked at various resources.
There are two second-level elixirs, eight first-level elixirs, and more than 600 pieces of fairy crystals. Various cultivation resources and fairy materials are also worth 300 fairy crystals.
There are dozens of purple fire crystals, two of which have reached the early stage of true immortality, which is good, good.
tumultuous!
A flame burned, and the flames steamed into the void.
The sea-blue flames flowed like a liquid, from soft to tough, but the temperature was astonishingly high. The surrounding void was slightly distorted by the burning, and melting cracks appeared on the ground.
Although the flame is only one foot in size and extremely restrained, it contains the power to burn mountains and boil seas.
Li Qingyuan smiled: I didn't expect there would be an unexpected gain.
This Hai Xin Kun Yuan Fire has grown to the second level of Immortal Fire.
The Kun Yuan Fire in the Heart of the Sea, the fire of Kun Yin, is extremely soft and tough, and can burn all things. It has been warmed by the Hai Yuan and nourished in the natal magic weapon for a hundred thousand years. The fire spirit has become quite intelligent, and the law of flame is also quite condensed.
If a mid-level True Immortal cultivator refines this fire, and with the aid of superb fire control techniques, his combat power will definitely be at the top of the same level.
Li Qingyuan raised his hand, and Nanming Lihuo flew out.
The moment the orange-red flame flew out of the palm, the fire spirit's will suddenly became violent. As soon as it saw Hai Xinkun's Yuanhuo, it suddenly burst out with a strong desire to devour.
The orange-red flames surged and transformed into the form of Suzaku.
A miniature Suzaku about ten feet in size spreads its wings in the void, with purple meaning flowing on its orange-red wings, its beak is like a sharp sword, and its eyes are like torches - the original form of Nanming Lihuo, the Suzaku Dharma Appearance, one of the four ancient divine beasts.
The Suzaku roared and rushed towards Hai Xinkun Yuanhuo.
Nanming Lihuo suddenly appeared, alarming Hai Xinkun Yuanhuo.
The sea blue flame suddenly shrank, and the fire spirit was instinctively afraid. The fire spirit of the second-level fairy fire was already quite intelligent and could clearly sense the suppressive power of the innate divine fire on Nan Ming Lihuo.
This is the natural restraint of the innate divine fire on the acquired immortal fire, just like a true dragon suppresses a snake and python, and a phoenix suppresses mortal birds.
Hai Xinkun Yuanhuo burst out with the power of fairy fire crazily, sea blue flames gushing out like a tide, trying to escape.
"Want to leave?"
However, Li Qingyuan grasped it with five fingers, and the power of the five disasters imprisoned him.
The five-color divine light silently enveloped the Hai Xinkun Yuan Fire. The five disasters merged into one, and the second-level fairy fire could not move.
Hai Xinkun's Yuanhuo became a lamb to be slaughtered. The fire spirit struggled fiercely, and the sea blue flames continued to attack the confinement of the five-color divine light, but it was like a trapped beast fighting, with no effect.
In the end, it was swallowed up by Nan Mingli's Suzaku beast.
The Suzaku spread its wings, its beak like a sharp sword, grabbed the Hai Xinkun Yuan Fire in one mouthful, and swallowed it whole into its belly. The sea blue flame was wrapped by the orange flame, and it quickly melted, absorbed, and refined.
After being swallowed by Nanming Lihuo, the origin of the first-order fairy fire burned.
The Nirvana attribute of the innate divine fire explodes. Nanming Lihuo is different from ordinary flames. It is an innate divine fire and is born with the ability to evolve into Nirvana.
It's like a ten thousand-foot-long Zhuque divine beast about to evolve into nirvana.
A Suzaku howl resounded across the sky, and the drastic changes in the law of fire could be felt for millions of miles around.
The Suzaku Dharma Appearance soared to ten thousand feet, the orange wings were filled with purple meanings, the temperature of the flames suddenly increased several times, the void was burned to cracks around the Suzaku Vulture Appearance, and the earth melted into magma.
The law of the great avenue of fire surges and transforms in Suzaku's body, and the origin of the second-order fairy fire of Haixinkun Yuanhuo is assimilated, absorbed, and fused with the innate divine fire of Nanming Lihuo.
